definitions.de: Auswählen; wählen — aus mehreren Möglichkeiten etwas oder jemanden auswählen
definitions.en: To choose; to select — to pick one option from among several available choices
definitions.es: Elegir; seleccionar — escoger una opción entre varias disponibles
definitions.fr: Choisir; sélectionner — choisir une option parmi plusieurs disponibles
definitions.hi: चुनना; चयन करना — कई उपलब्ध विकल्पों में से एक को चुनना
definitions.ja: 選ぶ；選択する — いくつかの選択肢の中から一つを選ぶ
definitions.km: ជ្រើសរើស; ពេញចិត្ត — ជ្រើសយកជម្រើសមួយពីជម្រើសច្រើន
definitions.ko: 선택하다; 고르다 — 여러 선택지 중에서 하나를 고르다
definitions.ne: छान्नु; छनोट गर्नु — धेरै उपलब्ध विकल्पहरूमध्ये एउटा रोज्नु
definitions.pt: Escolher; selecionar — escolher uma opção entre várias disponíveis
definitions.th: เลือก; คัดเลือก — เลือกตัวเลือกหนึ่งจากหลายตัวเลือกที่มีอยู่
definitions.tl: Pumili; mamili — pumili ng isang opsyon mula sa maraming pagpipilian
definitions.ur: چننا؛ منتخب کرنا — دستیاب کئی اختیارات میں سے ایک کا انتخاب کرنا
definitions.vi: Chọn; lựa chọn — chọn một tùy chọn trong số nhiều lựa chọn có sẵn
definitions.zh: 选择；挑选 — 从多个可选项中挑选一个
definitions.zh_Hant: 選擇；挑選 — 從多個可選項中挑選一個

definition_en: To choose; to select — to pick one option from among several available choices
